policy: One-line visual definition per MOSCATO state. Shown to the adapter instead of alias lists so the label must follow from what is visible, not from word overlap with TubeletGraph text.

definitions.chopped: the bread has been cut into several smaller pieces
definitions.jam-topped: a red or purple fruit preserve is visibly on the bread surface and no nut butter is present
definitions.on dish: plain bread slices resting on a plate or dish with nothing on their surface; they may be stacked
definitions.peanut butter topped: a tan or brown nut butter is visibly on the bread surface and no fruit preserve is present
definitions.peanut-butter-and-jam-covered: both a tan nut butter and a red or purple fruit preserve are visible on the bread surface
definitions.placed: the bread has been set down on a surface other than a dish and its surface is unchanged
definitions.pressed-together: two slices have been closed face to face so their spread surfaces touch and form a sandwich
definitions.relocated: the bread has been moved to a different location and its surface is unchanged
